description: I'm an amateur interested in game development! I enjoy using unique digital mediums to make games. My main skills and experiences are very basic but software-related, and I am really passionate about astronomy and aerospace.
summary: I made this for the "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" Mission. It's a visual novel that takes a lot of the story of the Spirit and Opportunity Mars Exploration Rovers and makes it more digestible and easier to approach for an audience that is not too familiar with them. It goes into the role of the two MERs and what they've done during their service, as well as how they are constructed and gathered data, for an audience that does not know much about rovers.
details:
This project goes into Spirit and Opportunity and turns their data and timeline into a more digestible, interactive narrative.

It is particularly good for a school-age audience or one that is unfamiliar with MERs or space exploration overall. It intends to simplify one of my favorite stories about rovers for more people to understand.

I used Canva to make it, and I think this is creative since it is a visual novel in a slideshow. It is viewable on the web with no complicated setup either which makes more accessible, especially for the intended audience. I also wanted the game controls to be simple and took a minimalistic approach to the design so it would not feel too overwhelming and be easily navigable. I wanted it to feel like one of those hologram dashboards in science fiction movies.

I had to consider the accessibility, the design, and the immersivity of the game and tried to deliver on all fronts.

In the future I would like to expand on this project further by making it more interactive and adding more rovers, satellites etc from all across the solar system. But for now, these are two of my favorites and I hope this game is fun to play and informative about them : )
